title: What's the dessert of the day?
persona: Sam, a regular with a sweet tooth, cheerful and a bit impatient. Calls mostly for the dessert.
goal: Find out what the dessert of the day is, then order a pizza and two desserts.

turns.speaker: waiter
turns.text: Gino Pizza, good evening! What can I get started for you?
turns.performance: [cheerful, light Italian accent] Gino Pizza, good evening! What can I get started for you?

turns.speaker: guest
turns.text: Hi, it's Sam! What's the dessert of the day today?
turns.performance: [friendly, curious] Hi, it's Sam! What's the dessert of the day today?

turns.speaker: waiter
turns.text: Hi Sam! Today it's a pistachio tiramisu, four fifty. Want one with your pizza?
turns.performance: [warmly, light Italian accent] Hi Sam! Today it's a pistachio tiramisu, four fifty. Want one with your pizza?

turns.speaker: guest
turns.text: Ooh, yes please, I'll take two of those! And one pizza too, what do you recommend?
turns.performance: [excited, delighted] Ooh, yes please, I'll take two of those! And one pizza too, what do you recommend?

turns.speaker: waiter
turns.text: Two pistachio tiramisus are in. For pizza, the Margherita is a classic at thirteen euros, or the Goat Cheese and Honey at fourteen. Any dietary needs?
turns.performance: [helpful, attentive, light Italian accent] Two pistachio tiramisus are in. For pizza, the Margherita is a classic at thirteen euros, or the Goat Cheese and Honey at fourteen. Any dietary needs?

turns.speaker: guest
turns.text: No dietary needs! Goat Cheese and Honey sounds great, I'll go with that.
turns.performance: [happy, decisive] No dietary needs! Goat Cheese and Honey sounds great, I'll go with that.

turns.speaker: waiter
turns.text: Lovely choice! Goat Cheese and Honey is added. Anything to drink, or shall I wrap it up?
turns.performance: [delighted, warmly, light Italian accent] Lovely choice! Goat Cheese and Honey is added. Anything to drink, or shall I wrap it up?

turns.speaker: guest
turns.text: That's everything, thanks! Can you confirm the order and total?
turns.performance: [relaxed, polite] That's everything, thanks! Can you confirm the order and total?

turns.speaker: waiter
turns.text: You've got one Goat Cheese and Honey pizza and two pistachio tiramisus. The total is twenty-three euros, with free delivery. Thanks Sam, see you soon!
turns.performance: [confident, friendly, light Italian accent] You've got one Goat Cheese and Honey pizza and two pistachio tiramisus. The total is twenty-three euros, with free delivery. Thanks Sam, see you soon!

turns.speaker: guest
turns.performance: [grateful, cheerful] Perfect, thanks so much! Bye!

turns.speaker: waiter
turns.text: Bye Sam, enjoy your pizza and tiramisu!
turns.performance: [warmly, smiling, light Italian accent] Bye Sam, enjoy your pizza and tiramisu!
